description_en: Supports automatic language identification for 31 languages in query scenarios and 35 languages in general scenarios. Applicable to short text language identification such as search terms, titles, and conversations
description_zh: 支持Query31 个语种，通用场景 35 个语种的自动识别，适用于搜索词，标题，会话这类短文本语种的识别
kebab_example: aliyun aidge language-detect --source-text '测试文本' --region cn-hangzhou
name: LanguageDetect

parameters.help_en: The source text to be identified. This parameter is required
parameters.name: source_text

parameters.help_en: The detection scenario. Default value: common. If you are using a search phrase scenario, set this parameter to query. If an incorrect value is passed or the parameter is not specified, the common general identification is used. Note: pass query in lowercase
parameters.help_zh: 默认common，如您是搜索短语的场景请传query，传错或者不传则走common通用识别（注：query请传入小写）
parameters.name: scene

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of 200 indicates a successful call. For other response codes, refer to the error code information
Code.description_zh: 响应代码，200代表调用成功，其他的响应代码可以参考错误码信息
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The language identification result data, including the detected language and usage information
Data.description_zh: 语种识别结果数据，包含识别到的语种和用量信息

UsageMap.description_en: The usage information, including the number of input characters
UsageMap.description_zh: 用量信息，包含输入字符数等

Message.description_en: The error message. "Success" is returned for a successful call. A specific error message is returned for an exception, such as "The parameters contain sensitive information. Try other input."
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"，异常时返回具体错误信息，例如"参数中包含敏感信息，请尝试其他输入"
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to uniquely identify a request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true代表成功，false代表失败
